metadata.description: IHP Roster architecture evidence generated from source, schema, routes, modules, generated contracts, and optional runtime artifacts.
metadata.factModel: project-local v2 entities/relationships with source provenance, heuristic classifiers, and confidence in query results; diagrams are derived views

facts.description: Generate canonical IHP architecture facts JSON under output/architecture/.

schema.description: Generate database schema DOT/SVG diagrams from Application/Schema.sql.

module-graph.description: Generate Haskell module dependency DOT/SVG graph.

runtime-overlay.description: Generate architecture timing overlay from OpenTelemetry profile artifacts.

component.description: Generate a generic focused diagram around a controller, action, table, or module.
component.intent: Fallback component neighborhood from observed IHP/schema/module facts.

controller.description: Generate a grouped controller/action surface report.
controller.intent: Inspect a controller by action kind, handler source, and inbound action references.

request-flow.description: Generate a static request-flow report for an action.
request-flow.intent: Explain action -> controller -> handler -> auth/scope -> data/response/realtime using source-derived heuristic facts.

realtime-usage.description: Generate realtime/live freshness usage metrics and diagram.
realtime-usage.intent: Measure usage of live freshness mechanisms without assuming the current websocket/fragment mechanism is permanent.

generated-contracts.description: Generate Haskell contract/codecs to generated TypeScript report.
generated-contracts.intent: Show backend-owned frontend contract sources, generated TypeScript, data attributes, and frontend consumers.

table.description: Generate a classified schema neighborhood for a table.
table.intent: Inspect domain vs audit/tenant/integration relationships around a table with optional audit edge expansion.

module.description: Generate a filtered module dependency neighborhood.
module.intent: Inspect imports around one module with common framework imports hidden by default.

trace.description: Generate a focused timing/request diagram from OpenTelemetry trace artifacts.
trace.intent: Explain an observed runtime request from trace artifacts without treating runtime traces as the full static architecture.
